messages:
sophie: Heads up — onboarding sample 'starter-onboard' failed parsing during a tool fncall in jsonMode. Repro is tiny and consistent.
sophie: Flow: client.callTool(..., { jsonMode: true }) -> transient 401 mid-stream triggers SDK retry -> assembly emits a different top-level shape than original.
rahul: Which SDK + version? node/py? TS/JS?
sophie: node@1.11.0 (TS), sampleapp starter-onboard. Customer demo hit it. Python SDK preserved original shape.
kevin: Can you paste a minimal trace?
sophie: Sure, log excerpt:
```
transport frame 0: {"items": [{"id": "x"}], "meta": {}}
auth refresh -> retry replay frames
assembly result: {"items": {"id": "x"}, "meta": {}}
validator: schema mismatch: expected array for "items", got object
```
zara: Whoa — assembly collapsed array->object. Why is it collapsing?
sophie: Looks like during replay the assembler flattens frames when it thinks there was a single logical payload. That heuristic breaks when top-level field is array.
rahul: Parity tests missed this because they only simulated clean streams. We should add a replay path fuzz harness.
kevin: Short-term mitigation options: 1) preserve a stream-header like __rw_shape for each top-level field and keep it across retries, 2) collapse single-element arrays only when schema explicitly forbids arrays, 3) add a jsonStrict flag (default false) that rejects any coercion.
zara: I prefer option 1 + 3: header makes behavior deterministic, strict flag gives customers control.
sophie: Also propose we mark the node sample as "known-parity-issue" in onboarding docs until fixed — customer-facing demos should avoid it.
rahul: I'll add a CI fuzz job that runs both SDKs against randomized chunk/retry sequences (auth 401, timeouts, dup frames) and assert validator outcomes are identical.
kevin: I'll open a PR to: 1) attach lightweight __rw_shape envelope on first frame, 2) ensure assembler retains it across retries, 3) add jsonStrict option to SDK config, 4) unit tests and parity e2e against sampleapp.
devex-bot: Created ticket DX-5055: "node: preserve field shape envelope across retries + jsonStrict opt". Labels: dx, sdk-parity, onboarding, hotfix.
sophie: Thanks — attaching tiny repro and recorded frames to DX-5055. This blocked two demos; a hotfix would be great. :pray:
rahul: Also adding assembly-debug logs behind debug=true so support can triage without full traces.
zara: I'll update onboarding doc to call out the temporary workaround and link the ticket.
sophie: Appreciate it :thumbsup:
